facts.text: A soft target is a person or vehicle dummy that a machine can hit without damage; a robotic target or target platform is a low, self-driving carrier that moves the dummy along a programmed path. ISO 19206 is the standard series specifying such targets for road-vehicle testing.
facts.quote: A soft target is a dummy of a person or vehicle that a machine can hit without damage, a robotic target or target platform is a low, self-driving carrier that moves the dummy along a programmed path,

facts.text: Road-vehicle testing uses foam and fabric pedestrian dummies designed to resemble pedestrians to cameras, reflect radar like a human body and return laser light like clothing, mounted on flat robotic platforms that follow repeatable paths at set speeds.
facts.quote: foam and fabric dummies that look like a pedestrian to a camera, reflect radar like a human body and return laser light like clothing, mounted on flat robotic platforms that drive repeatable paths at set speeds.

facts.text: The ISO 19206 series specifies pedestrian, bicycle and vehicle targets for testing.
facts.quote: The ISO 19206 series specifies these pedestrian, bicycle and vehicle targets

facts.text: Euro NCAP protocols reference Parts 2 and 4 of ISO 19206.
facts.quote: the Euro NCAP protocols reference Parts 2 and 4 [Chapter 3]

facts.text: A 2021 report by the United States road-safety regulator describes robots and soft targets automating approach speeds, crossing paths and repeated near-collision runs.
facts.quote: Robots and soft targets automate approach speeds, crossing paths and repeated near-collision runs, as a 2021 report by the United States road-safety regulator describes [Chapter 1].

facts.text: Road-vehicle robotic target platforms are built for passenger-car speeds and shapes.
facts.quote: These platforms are built for passenger-car speeds and shapes

facts.text: The booklet found no off-road equivalent of a Euro NCAP protocol.
facts.quote: no off-road equivalent of a Euro NCAP protocol

facts.text: The booklet found no publicly documented high-throughput robotic-target system for heavy machines.
facts.quote: no publicly documented high-throughput robotic-target system for heavy machines were found

facts.text: The booklet treats robotic-target automation for heavy off-road machines as a candidate investment, not a proven shortcut, because no off-road Euro NCAP-equivalent protocol or publicly documented high-throughput robotic-target system was found.
facts.quote: so the booklet treats robotic automation as a candidate investment, not a proven shortcut [Chapter 1]

facts.text: Off-road test surrogates must represent people in protective clothing, light vehicles under the nose of a haul truck, machines and fixed obstacles, matching camera appearance, radar cross-section, lidar reflectivity and ultrasonic response to each sensor.
facts.quote: Off-road surrogates must represent people in protective clothing, light vehicles under the nose of a haul truck, machines and fixed obstacles, with camera appearance, radar cross-section, lidar reflectivity and ultrasonic response matched to each sensor

facts.text: An optically realistic off-road test dummy may have the wrong radar signature.
facts.quote: an optically realistic dummy may have the wrong radar signature [Chapter 3]

facts.text: The South African test specification uses light vehicles for the controller test on a proving ground.
facts.quote: The South African test specification uses light vehicles for the controller test on a proving ground [Chapter 7].

facts.text: The booklet recommends that the sensor decision not be delayed, because test targets must be realistic to the chosen sensors.
facts.quote: Targets must be realistic to the chosen sensors, which is one more reason the booklet says the sensor decision cannot wait [Chapter 1].
